initial_publish.body_with_url:
Family moments, thoughtfully coordinated. We share mommy & me, daddy & me, and family outfit ideas, with help on sizes and what each selection includes. Planning photos? Start with our guide:
https://www.dresslikemommy.com/blogs/news/what-to-wear-for-family-photos-matching-outfit-ideas?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=organic_202609&utm_content=x_pinned_family_photo_guide

media.brief: An original, readable text card in the approved profile palette: 'Plan a family-photo look' with three short lines: 'Choose a shared palette', 'Check each person's size', 'Confirm what each selection includes'. Use brand typography and ample spacing. No garment, price, customer, or delivery illustration.
media.alt_text_candidate: Dress Like Mommy. Plan a family-photo look: 01 Choose a shared palette; 02 Check each person's size; 03 Confirm what each selection includes. Ivory background with plum text and rose accents.

rollback.profile: Restore captured original field values and original header/avatar, then verify public readback.
rollback.pinned_post: Unpin only the newly published intro if needed. Do not claim unpinning retracts its distribution. Permanent deletion requires specific authorization. If a prior pinned post exists in the fresh before-state, capture its exact URL and restore that prior pin after unpinning the new one.
rollback.reach: Public distribution cannot be fully reversed; no guaranteed recovery of past reach or engagement.
rollback.missing_before_assets: Blocks avatar/header replacement until original assets are captured.
